no_adcom_quote.quote: This Application did not raise any concerns that required an Advisory Committee Meeting or other external consultations.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the ULTOMIRIS (ravulizumab) BLA761108 approval. The Multidisciplinary Review's Section 9 states the application did not raise any concerns requiring an Advisory Committee Meeting. The only 'Advisory Committee' mentions in the review documents refer to the CDC's Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) vaccination guidance and a 2014 Soliris/eculizumab meeting, neither of which is an AdComm for this application.
